newsitem.title: USA: Easy re-election for House Speaker Gingrich.
newsitem.headline: Easy re-election for House Speaker Gingrich.

text.p: Georgia Republican Newt Gingrich, the firebrand speaker of the House of Representatives, easily defeated millionaire cookie magnate Michael Coles, a Democrat, television networks projected on Tuesday.

Gingrich is expected to be re-elected House Speaker if Republicans retain control. But polls show Gingrich, who helped Republicans take control of the House in 1994 for the first time in 40 years, is one of the most unpopular political figures in the nation. He also faces an ethics probe into whether he wrongly used a tax-exempt foundation for political purposes.
